entry.title: Revvy85 0.4.0
entry.summary: First public release. Revvy85 emulates the hardware of a 1985 digital reverb (HD6303R host, two YM3804 DSPs, YM3807 modulation chip) and runs **your own dump of its V1.0 program EPROM**. No firmware is included: put `rev7_v1.0.bin` (32 KB) in `Content/roms/` of the plugin folder, or add it in the Open MPC installer's "Your ROMs and files" step. Without it the plugin passes audio through. - MPC Gen2 (64-bit) only; tested on an MPC Key 37, MPC OS 3.10.1.12. - Front-panel skin: live 2 x 16 display,
